auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding a petition filed on May 15, 2026, under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 by Travel Food Services Limited, an operational creditor, before the National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Branch, alleging default in payment and seeking initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) against the Company for an amount aggregating to approximately INR 114.00 million.
